instruction: Create a data validation dropdown for the "Pass/Fail/Held" column with the options "Success", "Failure", "Deferred", and "Cancelled". Apply this to all cells in the column without changing other parts of the spreadsheet.

metadata.explanation: Task variation requiring a four-option outcome dropdown (Success, Failure, Deferred, Cancelled) in column D. Uses compare_table metric with data_validation rules. Same complexity as original task.
